name: Recent Items
desc: Settings for the Recent Items module.
filter.name: Filters
filter.display_items.name: Display Items
filter.display_only_personal.name: Display Only Personal
filter.display_only_personal.desc: Only display items relevant to you.
filter.display_locations.name: Display Locations
filter.display_locations.desc: Display locations along with the items. Warning: Location names can be very long.
filter.item_count.name: Item Count
recent.items.filter.item_count.desc: The amount of recent items to display.
visuals.name: Visuals
visuals.desc: Change how the recent items are displayed.
visuals.interpolation.name: Interpolation
visuals.interpolation.desc: How the items move from one position to another.
visuals.interpolation.values.0.name: Smooth
visuals.interpolation.values.1.name: Instant
visuals.fade_method.name: Fade Method
visuals.fade_method.desc: How items should fade in and out.
visuals.fade_method.values.0.name: Fade
visuals.fade_method.values.1.name: Slide
visuals.fade_method.values.2.name: Capture
visuals.fade_after.name: Fade After
visuals.fade_after.desc: How many seconds should an item be visible for before fading. Set to 0 to show permanently.
visuals.background.name: Background
visuals.background.desc: Select the type of background to use.
visuals.background.values.0.name: Transparent
visuals.background.values.1.name: Per Item
visuals.background.values.2.name: Block
position.name: Positioning
position.desc: Position the items on the screen.
position.x.name: X
position.x.desc: Horizontal position of the recent items display as a percentage of the window width.
position.y.name: Y
position.y.desc: Vertical position of the recent items display as a percentage of the window height.
position.alignment.name: Alignment
position.alignment.desc: Whether to align the items to the left, right, or center of the display.
position.alignment.values.0.name: Left
position.alignment.values.1.name: Center
position.alignment.values.2.name: Right
